jobs.occupation: Join Native Nanny – International Childcare Opportunities in Berlin (Kinderbetreuer/in)
jobs.description:
At Native Nanny, we specialize in international childcare across Germany. We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.

We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Berlin and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!

Your Responsibilities

- Provide loving, attentive, and safe care for children.
- Organize and structure daily routines with age-appropriate activities such as games, creative play, reading, or homework support.
- Accompany children to and from school, nursery, or extracurricular activities.
- Handle light, child-related housekeeping: meal prep, tidying play areas, laundry, etc.

Your Profile

- Experience with children or babies is essential. A background in education or childcare is a strong advantage.
- You’re caring, empathetic, and genuinely enjoy working with children.
- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.
- You have a friendly, open, and professional attitude.
- You speak English, French, Italian, or another common European language fluently.

Why Join Us?

- Bring your cultural diversity and language skills into a role where they truly make a difference.
- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.
- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.

If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!

jobs.occupation: Lead System Engineer (m/f/d) for the NEW ATHENA-WFI satellite project (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE) in
Garching (near Munich), Germany, is a world-leading institute for
developing and operating state-of-the-art astronomical instruments.
Over the past years, MPE has taken a leading role in the development
of instrumentation for several international space- and ground-based
projects, for example XMM-Newton, Herschel, SRG/eROSITA, EUCLID, the
VLT telescopes (e.g. KMOS, GRAVITY) and Einstein Probe. The MPE
High-Energy group, led by Prof. K. Nandra, carries out major space
hardware programs including the development of X-ray detectors and
X-ray optics in support of its astrophysics research program. Within
the framework of ESA’s future large-class space mission New Athena,
MPE leads the international consortium developing the Wide Field
Imager (WFI), one of the two instruments aboard the X-ray satellite.
Further details about the WFI, which is based on the Max Planck
Society’s unique Silicon DEPFET technology, can be found here:
https://www.mpe.mpg.de/ATHENA-WFI/ The MPE High Energy group is
seeking an experienced Lead System Engineer for the WFI project, who
should in addition have in their earlier career stages been an
accomplished design engineer in any of the primary engineering
disciplines (electronics, optical, mechanical, control and/or software
engineering). As electronics forms the technical core of the
instrument, a design background in electronics engineering is
considered a particular asset. As the Lead System Engineer for the New
Athena WFI, you will be part of the Project Management Team. Working
as a senior member of the WFI team, reporting to the Principal
Investigator and the Project Manager, you will have ample
opportunities to innovate and develop new technical solutions. Lead
System Engineer (m/f/d) for the NEW ATHENA-WFI satellite project Job
Code: 18/2026 Your Tasks: Act as the technical authority for the whole
WFI instrument, establishing, maintaining and controlling the
instrument-level technical baseline throughout the project lifecycle.
Be responsible for the project's technical configuration management.
Work in close and continuous collaboration with the Project Manager,
Project Scientist and the engineering team. Requirements engineering.
Definition and control of technical interfaces (external:
WFI-to-spacecraft; internal: between WFI sub-systems), ensuring
consistency across all responsible sub-system teams. Application of
end-to-end systems analysis and modelling and the subsequent
allocation and management of technical budgets/​tolerances.
Definition of the verification requirements and success criteria that
integration and test plans must satisfy, in coordination with the MAIT
Manager. Support of system integration, verification and testing,
acting as the primary technical interface towards ESA and consortium
partners. Technical Management and Risk Assessment. Prepare technical
documentation for milestones and reviews, assist the Project Manager
with schedule development and resource planning, and monitor
engineering progress against the project schedule, coordinating the
technical actions needed to support timely achievement of engineering
milestones. Your Qualifications: Essential: A completed scientific
university degree (M.Sc. or Dipl.‑Ing.) in engineering or an
equivalent qualification with in‑depth knowledge of scientific
instrumentation development. A physics degree with applicable work
experience in instrumentation development will also be considered.
Desirable: Given that electronics is the technical core of the
instrument, prior design experience in electronics engineering is
regarded as a particular asset, though applicants with a strong
background in the other primary engineering disciplines are equally
encouraged to apply. A higher degree (Ph.D.) in System Engineering
would be an advantage. Knowledge and Experience: Successful candidate
is expected to bring proven systems engineering experience with
designing astronomical or other complex systems. Knowledge of:
Engineering management with a broad knowledge of the technologies
involved in the engineering activities being managed. Principles and
methods of systems engineering and requirements analysis. Technical
risk assessment. Modelling languages, and relevant software tools.
Characterisation methods to evaluate candidate design alternatives.
System integration, tools, test equipment, principles and methods of
validation. Knowledge of ESA design and quality requirements (ECSS
standards) is an advantage. Electronics design principles

jobs.description:
For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
- Participate in building up clock-based experiments at Humboldt University, DESY, Heidelberg or U. Birmingham
- Analyse experimental atomic clock data and participate in the interpretation of results

About you:

- Experience in one of the relevant physics fields (e.g. particle, atomic/nuclear physics, quantum optics) with Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with detector physics, with good computer programming skills
- Very good command of English is required and knowledge of German is of advantage
- Willingness to travel and participate in working meetings, conferences, and field work abroad (e.g. at MPIK Heidelberg)
- Strong motivation, very good organizational skills, resilience; ability to work in teams and excellent communication skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the

TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Prof. Steven Worm at +49 33762-7-7208 [(steven.worm@desy.de).](https://mailto:(steven.worm@desy.de)

DESY in Zeuthen does not grant doctoral degrees directly but collaborates with the University of Potsdam or the Humboldt University. jobs.occupation: Senior Communications Manager (m/w/d) (Kommunikationswissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description:
Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

jobs.description:
Snapshot of your Day

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Working closely with more than 30 factories across our global Manufacturing Network, you will contribute to the development and adoption of our secure, centrally governed, and AI-enabled Data Mesh.

Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
